notes.general_comments: General comments Candidates found Questions 1, 5, 7, 10, 11, 12, 14, 16, 18, 19, 21, 24, 28, 33 and 36 to be more accessible than other questions. Candidates found Questions 3, 9, 13, 20, 37 and 39 to be more challenging. The questions that were found to be particularly difficult will now be looked at in greater detail. Comments on specific questions The most commonly chosen incorrect answer was B. Answer B, propane, is incorrect because the bond angle at each carbon atom is close to 109°. Answer D, sulfur hexafluoride, is correct as the bond angles are all 90°, thus there are three sets of F-S-F atoms that form a straight line.
